tweaks.title: Set 24-Hour Clock
tweaks.description: Changes clock to display 24-hour format.

scripts.apply:
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\International" -Name "sShortTime" -Value "HH:mm"
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\International" -Name "sTimeFormat" -Value "HH:mm:ss"
Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force

Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\International" -Name "sTimeFormat" -Value "h:mm:ss tt"
Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force

scripts.unapply: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" -Name "TaskbarAl" -Type DWord -Value 1

tweaks.title: Disable CPU Idle States
tweaks.description: Disables CPU idle states in the power plan to cut latency and micro-stutters in games

scripts.apply:
Write-Host "Disabling CPU idle states..."
powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 1
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 1
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
Write-Host "CPU idle states disabled."
scripts.unapply:
Write-Host "Restoring CPU idle states..."
powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 0
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 0
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
Write-Host "CPU idle states restored."

function Get-FriendlyName {
    param([string]$PackageName)

    $def = $appDefinitions | Where-Object { $_.Package -eq $PackageName }

    return $PackageName -replace "MicrosoftCorporationII\.", "" -replace "Microsoft\.", "" -replace "\.", " "
}

tweaks.title: Set Time To UTC
tweaks.description: Sets the system time to UTC, Great for dual booting

scripts.apply: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation" -Name "RealTimeIsUniversal" -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force
scripts.unapply: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation" -Name "RealTimeIsUniversal" -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force

tweaks.title: Set Win32 Priority Separation
tweaks.description: Optimizes foreground app performance by modifying system process priority behavior.

scripts.apply: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl" -Name "Win32PrioritySeparation" -Type DWord -Value 36
scripts.unapply: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl" -Name "Win32PrioritySeparation" -Type DWord -Value 2

tweaks.title: Show Seconds in Taskbar Clock
tweaks.description: Enables the seconds next to the clock in the taskbar

scripts.apply:
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" -Name "ShowSecondsInSystemClock" -Type DWord -Value 1

Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force
Start-Process explorer
scripts.unapply:
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" -Name "ShowSecondsInSystemClock" -Type DWord -Value 0

Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force
Start-Process explorer

tweaks.title: Gaming System Responsiveness
tweaks.description: Reserves more CPU time for games instead of background tasks

scripts.apply:
Write-Host "Setting gaming system responsiveness..."
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" -Name "SystemResponsiveness" -Value 10 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "System responsiveness set for gaming."
scripts.unapply:
Write-Host "Restoring system responsiveness..."
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" -Name "SystemResponsiveness" -Value 20 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "System responsiveness restored."

tweaks.title: Enforce Pure UEFI (Disable CSM)
tweaks.description: Checks boot mode and reboots to BIOS to disable CSM for pure UEFI with faster boot

scripts.apply:
Write-Host "Rebooting to UEFI firmware to disable CSM..."
shutdown /r /fw /t 0
Write-Host "Reboot command sent."

tweaks.title: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Enables And Applies The Windows Ultimate Powerplan for better performance

tweaks.title: Disable Virtualization Security
tweaks.description: Turns off VBS and HVCI virtualization security to free CPU for games

scripts.apply:
Write-Host "Disabling virtualization-based security..."
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard" -Name "EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity" -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force
New-Item -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" -Name "Enabled" -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "Virtualization-based security disabled. Restart required."
scripts.unapply:
Write-Host "Restoring virtualization-based security..."
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard" -Name "EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity" -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" -Name "Enabled" -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "Virtualization-based security restored. Restart required."

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Platform Binary Table
tweaks.description: Prevents your computer vendor from executing programs at boot, reducing potential security risks.

scripts.apply:
$regPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager"
$regName = "DisableWpbtExecution"
$applyValue = 1

if (-not (Test-Path $regPath)) {
    New-Item -Path $regPath -Force | Out-Null
}

Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name $regName -Value $applyValue -Type DWord

Write-Host "WPBT execution disabled."

tweaks.title: Enable XMP / EXPO RAM Profile
tweaks.description: Checks if RAM runs below rated speed and reboots to BIOS to enable XMP/EXPO for full memory speed

scripts.apply:
Write-Host "Rebooting to UEFI firmware to enable XMP/EXPO..."
shutdown /r /fw /t 0
Write-Host "Reboot command sent."
